scope: JE fixed-physics 6 V and 8 V numerical sensitivity, not thermodynamic model validation
refinement_limitation: Directional angular refinement only; radial and thickness convergence remain untested by this sequence
power_gap_reporting: Signed (JE volume - boundary power)/JE volume; report both all-exterior and electrode-only power
power_gap_threshold_note: No new acceptance threshold invented; report measured reduction and existing independent gates
preserve: Original physics, source, old inputs and results; write isolated new runs only
transfer: Initial guesses only; all new mesh results require native nonlinear re-equilibration
